subject: english
prompt: Two students are acting out a disagreement. Which line best keeps the conversation polite?

options.text: You are always wrong, so stop talking.
I will not listen to anyone.
Your idea is too silly to discuss.
I understand your idea, but I have a different suggestion.

answer.explanation: The first line acknowledges the other idea and introduces a different suggestion respectfully.
